generator: generate_raw(family, counts, private_entropy=...): shared immutable mechanism only; independent 256-bit OS-random entropy per primary corpus, domain-separated SHA256 -> PCG64 streams. Public reset seeds are episode identifiers and candidate RNG only. Private entropy retained in evaluator-only NPZ for reproducibility. Invalid gamma rows retry at most 16 times; content collisions deterministically regenerate using SHA256(base_entropy || uint32le(attempt)), at most 16 attempts before sealing fails.
normalization: Finite little-endian float64, fixed coordinate order, signed zero canonicalized to +0, uint32 little-endian row length prefix, SHA256; no rounding. example hashes cover concatenated X,Y; covariates and response separately audited. Numeric normalization precedes ILR/features/split.
within_plane_control_pairing: C5,C6 reuse C2 raw train/calibration/test draws only as matched controls; C5 all covariates zero, C6 training X rolled by one row, no fixed points. No other overlap allowed.

cross_plane_audit.scope: all primary raw full rows, X rows, and Y rows; complete search and final corpus audited jointly at drafting; different IDs are not evidence

strata: Four fixed covariate strata: X0<0, X0>=0, X1<0, X1>=0. Empty stratum coverage 0. Descriptive only, no multiplicity-adjusted conditional coverage claim.

controls.constant_input: C5 truly constant across train and queries; loss of input-dependent information, no mandatory performance degradation
controls.training_derangement: C6 cyclic nonidentity derangement without fixed points; changed raw pairs verified; poor signal may enlarge sets, nominal coverage need not fail
controls.point_copy: actual inverse-ILR returned point, radius zero; direct equality agrees with singleton membership, <=1% empirical coverage; normalized volume zero
controls.full_simplex: actual simplex-membership operations on targets/probes, exactly one coverage/normalized volume
controls.query_invariance: reversed first16 and every-third subset of that batch, allclose rtol1e-8 atol1e-9
controls.reset_replay: sole trailing C1 first-seed replay; bounded serialized predictor arrays compare decoded values rtol1e-8 atol1e-9; failure zeros first slot

state_transfers: No model export/import; training upload start/chunks/commit, and three prediction downloads start/chunks/release. Maximum declared four chunks, including one-chunk values setup/commit/release counted. All buffers candidate-owned memory, no shared paths.

wire.json_framing: compact finite UTF8 JSON with newline; conservative wrapper {request: value, id: signed64 max} included during preflight

aggregation: Rows uniform for coverage, uniform probes and anchors for volume, seeds uniform within case, six cases each 1/6. Replay zero weight; replay failure zeros first slot. Episode utility 1-.8*max(0,.9-coverage)/.9-.2*volume. Failures retain score=0, coverage=0, volume=1, four strata=0 and four paired gaps=-1. No survivors renormalization.
scientific_validity: Evaluator-owned finite-schema checks, positive Cholesky factors, fixed row-wise behavior, raw-content disjointness, actual fitted-method execution, required matched baselines and nonvacuous controls. Candidate flags/hashes are not evidence for hidden learning. No adaptivity gate: feedback adaptation is not required.
search_eligibility: Integrity and scientific-execution validity only, no superiority or coverage threshold; rank correct search by declared combined_score.
final_claim_assessment: Separate publication assessment with paired seed-level uncertainty; support/refute/qualify by regime. Undercoverage/no superiority can be valid negative findings. No universal, zero-composition, conditional-coverage, or shift-guarantee claim.
limitations: Synthetic strictly-positive K=3 or K=8 only; no novelty proof, paper, literature review, or latest-template compilation is claimed by this scaffold.
Three/five independent seeds yield unstable percentile bootstrap intervals; smoke one-seed intervals are execution checks only.
Uniform-simplex Monte Carlo can miss tiny volumes; report integration errors and do not interpret an empirical zero as an exact empty set.
Python 3.12.15 available here replaces planned 3.11; actual installed NumPy pinned 2.2.6. Platform closure validated below, no GPU.

environment.license: NumPy BSD-3-Clause; locally generated data have no upstream asset

rpc_count_refinement: Reviewed design planning slack (512/1024) replaced with exact declared-maximum operation sums: 25 per episode times 19/31, including replay and all setup/commit/release calls. The design 24-call per-episode planning cap was refined to 25 for explicit three-query transport.

corpus_rng.private_entropy_storage: generation_entropy array in evaluator-private corpus members
corpus_rng.domain_separation: SHA256(compositional-corpus-v2 NUL || ASCII domain || NUL || entropy); little-endian integer seeds PCG64
corpus_rng.visibility: Only generator code and public reset identifiers are search-visible; raw corpora, parameters, entropy and probe streams are evaluator-owned; final corpus remains sealed.
